name: Barbell Romanian Deadlift
grip: Double overhand, hands approximately shoulder-width apart.
description: A standing hip hinge that loads the back of the thighs and glutes. The hips move backward as the bar descends close to the legs.
setup: Stand with feet around hip-width and hold the bar in front of the thighs.
Soften the knees, brace the trunk and keep the neck aligned with the spine.
instructions: Push the hips backward while keeping the bar close and arms straight.
Lower only while you can maintain the hinge and a stable trunk; the plates need not reach the floor.
Keep roughly the same small knee bend rather than dropping into a squat.
Drive the hips forward to stand tall without leaning backward.
cues: Let the gaze follow the torso.
commonMistakes: Rounding the back to force extra depth.
Bending the knees into a squat or letting the bar drift forward.

logging.example: A 20 kg bar plus two 15 kg plates: record 50 kg total.
logging.note: Include the bar; keep equipment and load convention consistent.

variantNote: Starts upright and reverses at your controlled hinge depth; a conventional deadlift from the floor is separate.
reviewNotes: Use a range of motion appropriate to your own hinge.
